domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学

complete_examples.text: Accordingly, the system dynamics responses can be obtained at large time step size to promote computational efficiency, as illustrated in the work of [13].
Generally, the time step size is one of the key factors affecting the computational efficiency if the matrix inversion is inevitable.
